question: How many new students gained admission to AIMS Cameroon for the 2021-2022 academic year and what share were women?
answer: Fifty-Eight (58) new students, 45% of whom are women, gained admission to AIMS Cameroon to take a 10-month Master's Degree course in Mathematical Sciences during the 2021-2022 academic year.
